verdict.rationale: Shipping a game engine as an importable, tree-shakeable package is a fair question for game engines, so this axis applies. The evidence shows a full engine with a CLI/MCP setup for agents and web as an export target. Nothing documents the engine being installed from a package registry and imported, bundled, or tree-shaken as a library in an existing web toolchain. Web export and agent-skill installation are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a web developer, the engine installs from a package registry into my existing toolchain — a library I import, bundle, and tree-shake like any dependency
